headline: Aramark custodial contract, Raptor visitor management system, and a $37,115,362.91 expense manifest are on the agenda.
summary: Items include the tabled Aramark custodial contract, with a $4,841,202 annual fee. Also listed are a Raptor Technologies visitor system, a cafeteria table award, and an Amoskeag Health grant vendor approval.
items: Indemnification language in Double Tree and Trust In Us, LLC contracts
Replacement school cafeteria tables, bid results
Informational items, including fleet replacement plan and fiscal year 2028 budget discussion

Per the Strategic Plan, our Mission objective is to provide a transformational learning experience and ensure that every MSD learner has high

AGENDA 
MANCHESTER SCHOOL DISTRICT SAU #37 
COMMITTEE ON FINANCE & FACILITIES 
 
November 10, 2026  6:00 p.m. 
Committee Members, O’Connell, Turner, Parr, and Hamer  Aldermanic Chambers 
Student Representatives: Grace Ngira & Zahra Albadani (CHS)  City Hall (3rd Floor) 
 
1. Chairman O’Connell calls the meeting to order.  
 
2. The Clerk calls the roll.  
 
 
3. PUBLIC COMMENT 
 
a. Chairman O’Connell advises that the purpose of the public forum is to give the 
residents of Manchester the opportunity to address the committee on items of concerns 
affecting the community; that each person will be given only one opportunity to speak 
that comments shall be limited to three minutes to allow all participants the opportunity 
to speak and any comments must be directed to the Chair.  Any resident wishing to 
speak will come forward to the nearest microphone, clearly state their name and address 
when recognized and give their comments. 
 
b. Chairman O’Connell advises that if there was no one else present wishing to speak, a 
motion would be in order to take all comments under advisement and further to receive 
and file any written documentation presented. 
 
 
4.  Approval of minutes from October 21, 2026 Finance & Facilities meeting.

a. A motion is in order to go into non-public session under the provisions of RSA 91-A3 
II RSA 91-A:3 II  (i) consideration of matters relating to the preparation for and the

Consideration of confidential, commercial, or financial information that is exempt 
from public disclosure under RSA 91-A:5, IV in an adjudicative proceeding pursuant

student or pupil tuition contract authorized by RSA 194 or RSA 195-A and RSA 91-
